rule.primary: lowest SHA256(seed|receipt)20 receipts, fixed before HTTP
rule.augment: All extracted documents if total extracted<=20; otherwise at least10 extracted, plus first2 of every observed extraction state, ordered by same seed
rule.conflicts: All discovered source conflicts held regardless of sample
rule.expected_values: Human literal controls frozen from independent raw grids before opening production row amounts; no parser-derived expectations
rule.after_fix: A sample used to change parser becomes regression, fresh unused holdout required
